new.name: ClipmivoAI
new.description: ClipmivoAI is an AI video and image studio that plans and generates product videos, ads, UGC, music videos, explainers and short dramas from text, images or references, with templates for each format and an agent-skills option. It runs third-party models such as Seedance and Nano Banana on one credit balance, sold as one-time packs from $9.90 for 990 credits; you can plan three editable shots for free.

new.name: Task Mafia
new.description: Task Mafia is a task and shared-list app with optional AI help: plan your day in lists, a Kanban board or a day plan, share lists with people, and hand a task to your own connected AI agent, answer its questions and review its result before marking it done. The free plan includes 3 lists, 100 active tasks and 1 connected agent; Crew (£2.99 a month in the UK App Store) raises that to 50 lists and 10 agents.

new.name: Look Atlas
new.description: Look Atlas turns a single product photo into campaign-style AI model shoots and product videos for fashion, jewelry and e-commerce brands, with ghost-mannequin and mockup tools and a Shopify app. Plans start at $49 a month (80 credits, about 40 photos), Pro $99 adds human touch-ups and 2K, and Business $399 offers unlimited photos at 4K; you can try a first shoot free.

new.name: Delectus AI
new.description: Delectus AI is a French recruiting platform built on AI agents: it writes job ads, sources candidates and revives your existing CV database, pre-qualifies candidates by voice call, SMS and WhatsApp, and runs and scores interviews with transcripts and skill evaluations. It also targets IT consultancies and recruiting agencies (skills files, client-interview prep) and integrates with ATS tools. Pricing is by demo; the site is in French with other languages available.

new.name: Offloop
new.description: Offloop is an AI-native Slack alternative where people and AI agents work in the same channels. You mention an agent in a conversation and it uses the context your team already shared, asks for access when it needs it and posts updates in the thread, with files, schedules and connectors for Gmail, Slack, GitHub and more. New accounts get 200,000 free credits once; Individual is $99 a month and Team $999 a month, with no per-seat fees.

new.name: Nynch
new.description: Nynch is an AI CRM for consultants and fractional executives who win work through relationships. You choose who it watches; it tracks job changes, promotions, hiring, funding and leadership signals across your network, tells you who to contact, when and why, and drafts emails, posts and meeting prep in your voice, with proposals, deal rooms and pipeline in one place. Plans are annual only, starting with Solo at $179 a month billed yearly.

new.name: Adszy
new.description: Adszy is an AI agent for Google Ads: it reads your account through Google sign-in, finds wasted spend, ranks problems by cost and drafts fixes, and applies only the changes you approve. Adszy Connect brings the same Google Ads data into Claude, ChatGPT or Codex. A free plan gives 100 credits a month for one account; paid plans start at $99 a month (Solo), and Connect alone starts at $25 a month.

new.name: OpenLinker
new.description: OpenLinker is a platform for connecting, calling and coordinating AI agents. You can order a service with defined deliverables and get the result, call an agent directly, connect MCP tools or build multi-agent workflows, and every run keeps its status, artifacts and trace IDs. It runs hosted or on your own open-source Core, and exposes an MCP endpoint (Bearer token) with tools to search agents, run them, follow run events and create tasks.

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Firecrawl is an AGPL-3.0 web data API for AI agents, open source and available as a hosted service: Search returns full page content for web results, Scrape turns any URL into clean Markdown, HTML, screenshots or structured JSON, Crawl and Map cover whole sites, Interact clicks, scrolls and types before extracting, and Parse converts PDFs and DOCX files. It handles proxies, rate limits and JavaScript-heavy pages for you, and connects to any agent or MCP client with a single command.
